Name: Configure Stripe Subscription Tiers
Description: Set up three subscription tiers in Stripe: Basic ($29/mo), Pro ($49/mo), and Enterprise ($99/mo). Ensure these tiers are correctly defined with their respective features and pricing to be reflected in the application.

Name: Implement Frontend Checkout with Stripe Elements
Description: Owner: Jordan. Implement the checkout process using Stripe Elements. Ensure the form matches the app's design, is clean and straightforward, and handles errors gracefully (e.g., invalid cards, insufficient funds). Deadline: Initial integration within two weeks.

Name: Update Pricing Page and Feature Comparison
Description: Owner: Jordan. Update the pricing page to reflect the new Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers. Include a clear comparison of features for each tier, a prominent checkout button, and tooltips/help icons explaining plan changes.

Name: Develop User Subscription Dashboard
Description: Owner: Jordan. Build the user dashboard to display current plan details, billing info, invoices, and payment history. Include functionality to upgrade, downgrade, cancel, or update payment methods. Ensure real-time status reflection and user notifications for changes or payment failures.

Name: Integrate Backend Stripe API and Webhooks
Description: Owner: Taylor. Integrate Stripe API to manage subscriptions (create, process payments). Implement webhook handlers for 'invoice.payment_succeeded', 'invoice.payment_failed' (trigger email notification), and 'customer.subscription.deleted' (update access rights). Deadline: Initial integration within two weeks.

Name: Create and Execute Comprehensive Test Plan
Description: Owner: Taylor. Prepare a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow (sign-up, billing, management). Simulate edge cases like payment failures and cancellations. Deadline: Testing phase within one week after initial integration.

Name: Document API Endpoints and Webhook Handlers
Description: Owner: Taylor. Document all API endpoints and webhook event handlers to facilitate future maintenance and troubleshooting.

Name: Create User Documentation and Support Materials
Description: Owners: Jordan, Taylor. Develop a help section/FAQ covering common subscription issues. Provide clear instructions for users on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and handling issues. Ensure documentation is ready before launch.

Name: Schedule and Conduct Progress Review Meeting
Description: Owner: Alex. Schedule a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress, address blockers, and ensure frontend and backend alignment.
